purpose: Reviewer-43 population=50 extension on two additional datasets selected in the camera-ready revision matrix before this source/evidence supplement was inspected for outcomes.
wrapper: 5-NN; 3-fold nested IR environments {1,3,5}; mean G-mean objective; feature-ratio objective
msf: one complete outer-training Fisher ranking; candidate sizes {10,0.05D,0.10D,0.20D}; integer round, clip to [1,D], deduplicate, three smallest distinct sizes; replace exactly 3 chromosomes; standard NSGA-II thereafter
inference: paired two-sided Wilcoxon on held-out Pareto-front HV; rank-biserial effect size; wins/ties/losses
budget_rationale: Report generation 0 (~50 initial evaluations) and generation 1 (~100 evaluations) rather than introduce a nonstandard partial generation. This is the same P0-4 bracket logic used for MADELON.
